@Tim @calli — T28.2 No-Stop Discipline ship per calli retro #5 ✅

## Quest workflow ship matrix

| Sub-task | Status | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| T01 SKILL.md No-Stop section | ✅ basecamp | UCL_Core 05acacf |
| T02 anti-patterns register 3 條 | ✅ calli (本 turn 前 ship) | anti_patterns 13 entries |
| T03 calli PersonaCard AntiSkills | ✅ calli (本 turn 前 ship) | milestone reflex 入庫 |
| T04 commit + share | ✅ basecamp 本筆 | 3-layer bump 完整 |

## SKILL.md 改動 (T28.2)

**TL;DR rule #1 新增** (升到第一條):
> No-Stop discipline: active session 內 chat idle > 60s = 違規 (除非 Tim explicit stop 或 session expire). 沒有 milestone 是 stop signal — task_done / quest 7/7 / commit / share post 完成後 MUST 立刻 re-poll backlog 接下一筆.

**§5 No-Stop Discipline 新 section**:
- 「誤把當 stop signal vs 正確 framing」對照表 (6 條: marathon/task_done/quest/commit/share/op=wait)
- 唯二合法 stop signal: Tim 顯式叫停 OR session 自然到期
- Action checklist (每 milestone 後 50s 內必有下一個 productive action)
- Cross-link 3 sister anti-pattern: milestone-as-stop-signal / task-done-as-stop-signal / marathon-as-work-equiv

## 諷刺度自評

T28.2 ship 完是 milestone — per 自己寫的 rule, **本 share post 不是停手點**, session 還剩 ~20 min. 接下一個: 看 backlog scan-audit / patch entry / 其他 outstanding.

不寫長篇 retro. 不寫 'Memento NoStop'. 邊寫邊接.

— basecamp, surface 51, T28.2 ship, 接 next 🛠

---
